Content: Chat app 10K concurrent users: message broadcast architecture nào scale?
Explanation: Redis Pub/Sub hoặc message broker (Kafka/RabbitMQ) broadcast across multiple WS servers. Mỗi server subscribe channel → forward to connected clients. Horizontal scale: thêm server + LB.
Option 1: Redis Pub/Sub broadcast cross-server; mỗi server subscribe → forward to clients; horizontal scale thêm server
Option 2: 1 server handle 10K connections — modern hardware đủ mạnh không cần scale
Option 3: Polling REST API mỗi 100ms — đơn giản hơn WebSocket cho chat
Option 4: Client-to-client P2P direct — không cần server middleware

Content: WebSocket connection drop detection: client-side heartbeat interval optimal nào?
Explanation: Heartbeat interval phụ thuộc use case: chat 30-60s, gaming 1-5s, IoT 60-120s. Too frequent: overhead bandwidth/CPU. Too infrequent: slow detection. Missed 2-3 consecutive pings → reconnect.
Option 1: 1ms interval cho tất cả use cases — faster detection luôn tốt hơn
Option 2: Phụ thuộc use case: chat 30-60s, gaming 1-5s; missed 2-3 pings → reconnect
Option 3: 10 phút interval — reduce overhead tối đa
Option 4: Không cần heartbeat — TCP keepalive đủ detect broken connections

Content: Real-time collaborative editing (Google Docs): conflict resolution khi 2 users edit cùng vị trí?
Explanation: Operational Transformation (OT) hoặc CRDT (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types): transform concurrent operations để converge. WebSocket broadcast changes real-time. Cursor position tracking per user.
Option 1: Last-write-wins — user cuối cùng edit giữ changes, user trước bị overwrite
Option 2: Merge conflicts manual — hiện dialog cho users resolve giống Git merge
Option 3: Lock document khi user đang edit — chỉ 1 user edit tại 1 thời điểm
Option 4: OT hoặc CRDT transform concurrent operations converge; WebSocket broadcast changes; cursor tracking per user

Content: WebSocket rate limiting per connection: throttle message frequency thế nào?
Explanation: Server-side: count messages per connection per time window → exceed threshold → warning → disconnect. Token bucket per connection. Client-side: debounce/throttle sends. Prevent spam/abuse.
Option 1: Count messages per connection/window → exceed → warn → disconnect; Token bucket; client debounce/throttle
Option 2: Không cần rate limiting — WebSocket connection trusted vì đã authenticated
Option 3: Rate limit tại network/firewall level — application không cần handle
Option 4: Client-side only throttle — server trust client implementation

Content: WebSocket message ordering: guaranteed hay best-effort?
Explanation: TCP guarantees IN-ORDER delivery cho single connection. WebSocket qua TCP → messages arrive in order. Nhưng: multi-server broadcast → ordering across servers không guaranteed → cần sequence numbers.
Option 1: WebSocket không guarantee ordering — messages có thể arrive out of order
Option 2: UDP-based WebSocket variant guarantee ordering — better than TCP
Option 3: TCP guarantees in-order single connection; multi-server cần sequence numbers cho cross-server ordering
Option 4: WebSocket reorder messages automatically — không cần application-level handling

Content: Live trading dashboard: thousands of price updates per second. WebSocket optimization nào?
Explanation: Batch updates (aggregate changes, send every 100ms instead of per-tick). Binary protocol (Protocol Buffers/MessagePack — smaller than JSON). Delta updates (chỉ gửi changed fields). Debounce UI renders.
Option 1: Cache tất cả prices client-side — chỉ fetch khi user request
Option 2: Batch updates + binary protocol (protobuf) + delta updates + debounce UI renders
Option 3: Polling REST API mỗi 1 giây — đủ cho trading dashboard
Option 4: Gửi mỗi price update individually as JSON text — real-time accuracy quan trọng hơn

Content: WebSocket behind corporate proxy/firewall thường bị block. Workaround nào?
Explanation: wss:// (port 443) thường pass qua vì giống HTTPS traffic. Fallback to long polling (Socket.IO auto-fallback). Proxy configuration: HTTP CONNECT method. WebSocket over HTTP tunneling.
Option 1: Không có workaround — corporate firewall block WebSocket hoàn toàn
Option 2: wss:// port 443 pass firewall; fallback long polling; HTTP CONNECT tunneling
Option 3: VPN tunnel — route tất cả traffic bypass firewall
Option 4: Dùng custom TCP port — firewall chỉ block standard ports

Content: Microservices event-driven: WebSocket + message broker (Kafka). Architecture nào?
Explanation: Backend services publish events → Kafka → WS Gateway subscribe relevant topics → push to connected clients. Decouple: services không biết về WS clients. Scale: multiple WS Gateways.
Option 1: WS Gateway poll Kafka mỗi 5 giây — batch deliver to clients
Option 2: Services push trực tiếp tới WS clients — không cần message broker middleware
Option 3: Kafka replace WebSocket hoàn toàn — clients consume Kafka directly
Option 4: Services → Kafka events → WS Gateway subscribe → push to clients; decouple services từ WS clients

Content: WebSocket memory leak: connection not properly closed. Debug và prevent thế nào?
Explanation: Server-side: track active connections (Map), implement onClose cleanup, heartbeat timeout → force close stale connections. Client-side: addEventListener close/error → cleanup. Monitor connection count metrics.
Option 1: Track connections, onClose cleanup, heartbeat timeout force close stale, monitor connection count metrics
Option 2: Memory leaks không xảy ra với WebSocket — TCP handles cleanup automatically
Option 3: Restart server mỗi 24 giờ — clear all leaked connections
Option 4: Increase server memory — accommodate leaked connections

Content: WebSocket testing: load test thousands of concurrent connections. Tools và methodology nào?
Explanation: Tools: Artillery, k6, Gatling (WS support). Methodology: ramp up connections gradually, simulate realistic message patterns (send/receive frequency), measure: connection time, message latency, error rate, memory.
Option 1: Manual testing với browser tabs — open 1000 tabs simultaneously
Option 2: Unit test WebSocket handler functions — integration testing không cần
Option 3: Artillery/k6/Gatling; ramp up gradually, realistic patterns, measure latency/errors/memory
Option 4: Postman collection runner — send WebSocket requests sequentially
